BiblicalUsage: Tabbaoth was a family of the Nethinim, the temple servants, who returned from exile with Zerubbabel. The name means rings, and the family is named twice, in the two lists of the return. They are not a single person but a household, counted among those who served the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim deserve remembering: they were servants, not priests, and their names are still in the book, because God counts the servants too.
